reply.rationale: The defect is that the no-overlap disjunctive constraints are only generated for machines[:1] (M1), leaving M2 unconstrained so jobs assigned to M2 can overlap. The fix changes the loop to iterate over all machines, applying the same big-M disjunctive formulation to both M1 and M2. This is a minimal one-line local change that directly enforces R2 (no overlap on the same machine) without altering the model structure, objective, or output schema.
reply.risk_notes: Extending the disjunctive constraints to M2 adds more big-M constraints, which may slightly increase solver time, but with 5 jobs and 2 machines this is negligible. The big-M value (sum of proc times = 34) is valid for both machines since it bounds any start-time difference. No change to precedence, assignment, or makespan logic.
